author: faht
body:
Made by: Eric, Jive and Tazz

Images: http://imgur.com/a/BGavX

Features:
● 2 wools per side.
● Blue vs Red
● Based on team pushes.
● No iron.
● 2 potions of regeneration in middle.
● Tunnels in middle.
● Middle Island you have to hold.
● Spawn timer.
● Supplies in spawn.
● Supplies in the woolrooms: Chain chestplate ; Protection1, 8 golden apples, Power I bow.

Mapdevs/Officials, add Eric on skype for download: eric_mcgamer

Feedback is welcome.
-Eric, Jive and Tazz
